completion_semantics: The outcome task is closed by disabling an unsupported comparison. No missing class is fabricated and no descriptive award or presentation trace is relabeled as a decision outcome.
reactivation_gate: Provide independently sourced accept/reject or equivalent decision labels.
Document one shared sampling mechanism and denominator.
Record source URL, retrieval date, and class semantics for every row.
Keep any resulting contrast descriptive and conditional; do not estimate acceptance probability.
